source: Different architectures can change exactly what is stored. ZXNAME0000XZ is the clearest example: its decoupled positional component changes the cache structure compared with a conventional ZXNAME0001XZ/ZXNAME0002XZ model.
zh: 不同的架构可以准确地改变存储的内容。 ZXNAME0000XZ 是最明显的例子：与传统的 ZXNAME0001XZ/ZXNAME0002XZ 模型相比，其解耦的位置组件改变了缓存结构。
